# Generated by gen_p19.py - do not edit by hand.
source openssl verify for the root bundle and revocation (-CAfile with or without the root; no flag, -crl_check or -crl_check_all, one CRL per CA); the page's rules by hand for the SPKI blocklist and CT; a second, table-driven implementation agrees on every line
seed 1
compare records
explain _lines=R1
requirement R1 One verdict line per chain and client, chains in input order and clients in declaration order; a fact line affects only later chains; switches are read by key
requirement R2 `blocked-spki` rejects only clients with blocklist=yes (first role from the leaf); `distrusted-root` rejects only clients with bundle=updated
requirement R3 Revocation follows the switch: off never rejects, leaf looks up the leaf only, chain looks up every certificate and names the first revoked one from the leaf
requirement R4 ct=required rejects with missing-ct when the leaf is not logged, whatever the other certificates; ct=ignored never rejects
requirement R5 The reasons run in the order blocklist, root distrust, revocation, CT, and revocation and CT are independent of each other
requirement E2E Several clients and chains in one input, mixing every verdict

verdict clean-unlogged rev-only accept
verdict clean-logged rev-and-ct accept
verdict clean-logged ct-only accept
verdict clean-logged rev-only accept
end
